purpose: Preserve findInodeInfo's single actual FSTAT. A fixed native global-inode parent performs that stat, selects/creates the inode, then explicitly adopts the already completed receipt. It must never issue a second stat just to enter an inode-local child.

source_format.header: Original HIANDB01 fields, command10; exact next caller; handle0; nonzero actual FS token at64; readonly/excl two bits at72; source lease at120; payload656 at128; original other reserved fields zero.
source_format.payload: Exact actual FS operation15 request256B, completed FS result header256B, and its exact declared144B native stat data. No public/raw caller may supply an arbitrary alleged completed receipt.
source_format.borrowed_extent: The logical completed FS extent is400B. The fixed parent owns the original raw output buffer and custody; any separately retained output capacity/canaries remain evidence, not part of this canonical packet.

validation: Original DB nonce and exact next caller/source lease are validated before mutation.

Shared FS nonce must match the DB's initialized FS session; actual FS call and syscall serial must each be strictly newer than this child last consumed. Actual request op15, descriptor token and all reserved request fields are checked.
Actual request's nonzero physical-action lease is matched by the result. No new DB action or FS action is issued; successful output DB action remains0.

Only a successful completed FSTAT can be adopted. Its status, phase, version, exact declared144B extent, stat duplicate fields, raw dev/ino/mode/uid/gid/size/nlink and existing inode identity are validated.
The FS token must not already be owned by any active/deferred row. Successful adoption creates one fresh DB logical handle and reference; it does not issue a new descriptor.

Full912B source is copied into owned pending storage before a growth yield. Phase6 accepts only the same full912B bytes; changed source, wrong command/nonce/call, old receipt or unknown completion permanently refuses.
u64 row-count/extent guards precede addition and multiplication. Allocation uses existing16-row growth granularity, without a new maximum row or path quota.

workspace.completion: Clear full saved source and pending metadata. Preserve original current DB/FS watermarks and return the fresh logical handle.
workspace.original_commands: For commands1..9, only entry routing/steady recognition/common cleanup dispatch changed; original control algorithms and ordinary output/workspace meanings remain. Exact old40 controls must be executed on the new image before acceptance.

ownership: This is private framing and source binding, not authentication of external byte buffers.
Only a future fixed HIA parent that owns the actual shared FS session, the completed receipt lease, the selected inode registry and current call may issue command10.
The parent must serialize global inode selection and connect actual lifetime authority. A matching nonce/header copied from elsewhere is insufficient.
The parent must reserve its own connection transport storage before the original physical operations; representation GROW must not be reported as a fabricated original SQLite allocator result.

A newly allocated child must initialize FS watermarks below the one actual receipt being adopted; an existing child consumes the strictly newer actual receipt. This initialization is controlled by the native parent, never a public supplied session.

Original findInodeInfo FSTAT failure still belongs to the global parent before inode selection/allocation. It must preserve original IOERR/lastErrno/close-before-unlock ordering and must not pass a failed stat to command10.
Original inode malloc/mutex-allocation failure order, global inode list ownership and physical close remain the next native parent responsibility.
required_controls: All40 reconstructed-r3 C/VM and VM/native tests preserved, with unchanged private assertions and resource gates.
Single completed FSTAT registration on empty/existing inode, UID0/dev0/ino0, allreadonly/excl flags, reused deferred descriptor and fresh logical generation.
Actual successful FS result pairing with full buffers/canaries, exact watermarks, cross-session, replay, duplicate-token and stat-field mutations.
Full912-byte GROW retry and altered header/payload, reserved workspace/phase/counter corruption, short buffers and arithmetic edges.
Native global parent integration must prove one and only one actual FSTAT, not just a controlled receipt fixture.
open: Global inode/list registry and fixed call issuance
